---
directory: /media/music
library: /data/library.db
import:
  move: true
  from_scratch: true
asciify_paths: true
group_albums: true
per_disc_numbering: true
paths:
  default: "$albumartist/[%if{$year,$year,0000}] $album%aunique{}/%if{$multidisc,$disc-}$track - $title"
  albumtype:soundtrack: "000-soundtracks/$album [%if{$year,$year,0000}]%aunique{}/%if{$multidisc,$disc-}$track - $title"
  comp: "000-compilations/$album [%if{$year,$year,0000}]%aunique{}/%if{$multidisc,$disc-}$track - %if{$artist,$artist - }$title"
  singleton: "000-non-album/$artist/$title"
plugins:
  - albumtypes # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/albumtypes.html
  - discogs # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/discogs.html
  - duplicates # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en//stable/plugins/duplicates.html
  - extrafiles # https://github.com/Holzhaus/beets-extrafiles
  - fetchart # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/fetchart.html
  - ftintitle # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/ftintitle.html
  - inline # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/inline.html
  - lastgenre # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/lastgenre.html
  - lyrics # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/lyrics.html
  - missing # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/missing.html
  - mbsync # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/mbsync.html
  - scrub # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/scrub.html
  - web # https://beets.readthedocs.io/en/stable/plugins/web.html
discogs:
  source_weight: 0.0
  user_token: ${SECRET_DISCOGS_PAT}
extrafiles:
  patterns:
      all:
        - '*.*'
fetchart:
  cautious: true
  sources: itunes *
item_fields:
  multidisc: 1 if disctotal > 1 else 0
lastgenre:
  canonical: yes
lyrics:
  fallback: ''
  synced: true
fuzzy:
web:
  reverse_proxy: true
  host: 0.0.0.0

/hr/ghcr.io-home-operations-charts-mirro.title: external-dns helm release
/hr/ghcr.io-home-operations-charts-mirro.name: external-dns
/hr/ghcr.io-home-operations-charts-mirro.doc: ExternalDNS is a Kubernetes add-on that automatically manages the creation and updates of DNS records for services running in your cluster. It integrates with a variety of DNS providers, such as CloudFlare DNS, Amazon Route 53, Google Cloud DNS, and more, to ensure that your applications are easily accessible from anywhere with a DNS name. With ExternalDNS, you can simplify the process of managing DNS records for your home lab, eliminating the need for manual updates and reducing the risk of errors.

/hr/ghcr.io-bjw-s-helm-app-template-redi.title: redis helm release
/hr/ghcr.io-bjw-s-helm-app-template-redi.name: redis
/hr/ghcr.io-bjw-s-helm-app-template-redi.doc:
Redis is an open-source, in-memory data structure store that is used as a database, cache, and message broker. It provides a fast and flexible solution for storing and retrieving data, making it an ideal choice for a wide range of use cases, including real-time analytics, session management, and more.

Redis is used by Authentik, Authelia, oauth2-proxy.
